question: How many medals did Punjab University win at the Khelo India University Games event held in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**69**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Punjab University** secured an impressive tally of **69 medals** at the **Khelo India University Games 2023**, showcasing its dominance in the event.
 
• The medal haul included **26 gold medals**, which were instrumental in propelling Punjab University to the top of the medal table.
 
• The university also bagged **17 silver medals** and **26 bronze medals**, contributing to its overall total.
 
• Punjab University’s athletes excelled in various sports, including wrestling, athletics, and shooting, helping the university achieve this remarkable feat.
 
• The Khelo India University Games is a platform for nurturing young talent, and Punjab University’s performance highlighted its strong sports culture and infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India University Games 2023:**

 
 
• It is a flagship event under the **Khelo India initiative**, aimed at promoting grassroots-level sports and identifying talent for international competitions.
 
• The 2023 edition witnessed participation from over 200 universities across India, competing in various disciplines like athletics, wrestling, shooting, and swimming.
 
• The event was hosted in multiple cities, including Bengaluru, with significant support from the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• The** first edition** Khelo India University Games was held in **Odisha in 2020** at the Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) in Bhubaneswar and Cuttack.
 
• The **third edition** was hosted by **Uttar Pradesh in 2023**. The mascot was 'Jitu', a Barasingha (Swamp Deer), which is the state animal of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• **2024 edition**: The games were inaugurated in Guwahati, Assam, by the Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports, Anurag Singh Thakur.
 
 
 
• **Importance of the Khelo India Initiative:**
 
 
• Launched in 2018, the initiative aims to strengthen the sports ecosystem in India by providing financial assistance and infrastructure support.
 
• It focuses on the identification and nurturing of young talent through events like the Khelo India Youth Games and University Games.
 
• Scholarships and training facilities are provided to athletes under this program to ensure their holistic development.
